correctness.rationale: The original bracket is identified bijectively with the product of an a-by-2 and a 2-by-b matrix. Rank-stratifying the first factor gives all four fiber levels; the rank-two factorization is the only possible obstruction and central inputs contribute the exact factor q^(2ab). For width, rank subadditivity proves necessity and decomposition into paired rank-one tensors proves sufficiency over any field. Seven exhaustive finite-field cases, including GF(4) and a rank-three-unattainable case, matched all target fibers and normalization.

value.rationale: Complete target-wise finite-field bracket fibers and the exact width of a natural unbounded family of nilpotent graph Lie algebras answer a natural algebraic question absent from the foundational graph-isomorphism, ideal and abelian-subalgebra results. The sharp transition at min(a,b)=3 separates derived-ideal surjectivity from rank-two determinantal obstruction, and the width grows without bound. Both exact fiber multiplicities and sharp natural width have value beyond isolated enumeration or changed notation.
